name: ntt-public
description: NTT-public is a composite neural-spike dataset for tokenization research, spanning 1,104 sessions and ~266k units across 10 publicly-released brainsets (7 held-in for training and 3 held-out as cross-source evaluation). The dataset is distributed as a recipe: the NTT repository ships per-brainset selection YAMLs and a brainsets-based ingestion pipeline that materializes per-session HDF5 files from canonical public upstream sources (DANDI, Zenodo, AllenSDK, CRCNS, UCL RDR, Kilthub). This manifest documents the schema of those HDF5 files and references the upstream sources, the in-repo split selection YAMLs, and a per-brainset summary table of the assembled dataset.

recordSet.name: IBL_brainwide_2023
recordSet.description: IBL_brainwide_2023: 331 sessions, 101557 units, 26796.7 minutes of recording. Species: MUS_MUSCULUS. Recording tech: NEUROPIXELS_SPIKES. Brain areas: brain-wide (Allen CCF regions across forebrain, midbrain and hindbrain). Role: training + within-source evaluation.

field.name: spike_timestamps
field.description: Spike timestamps in seconds. Vector of length N_spikes.

field.name: spike_unit_index
field.description: Index into units/* for each spike. Vector of length N_spikes.

field.name: spike_train_mask
field.description: Train-split membership per spike. Vector of length N_spikes.

field.name: spike_valid_mask
field.description: Validation-split membership per spike. Vector of length N_spikes.

field.name: spike_test_mask
field.description: Test-split membership per spike. Vector of length N_spikes.

field.name: spike_domain_start
field.description: Trial-interval starts (seconds). VECTOR of length N_intervals: one entry per trial for trial-structured brainsets (flint, churchland, perich), one entry spanning the full session for non-trial-structured brainsets. Misreading this as a scalar yields a 5-second 'session duration' for trial-structured data.

field.name: spike_domain_end
field.description: Trial-interval ends (seconds). VECTOR of length N_intervals (paired with spike_domain_start).

field.name: unit_id
field.description: Per-unit identifier (bytes-encoded string in the source H5). Vector of length N_units.

field.name: unit_number
field.description: Per-unit integer index. Vector of length N_units.

field.name: unit_brain_area
field.description: Per-unit brain area label. The actual H5 key varies by brainset: area_name (default), structure_acronym (allen_visual_coding_neuropixels), allen_location | beryl_location | cosmos_location (IBL_brainwide_2023, in decreasing fineness). Brainsets without per-unit area data fall back to a default area string per RecordSet (see RecordSet.description). 11 IBL sessions have empty area strings even when the keys are present, so this field is nullable.

field.name: unit_firing_rate
field.description: Per-unit mean firing rate in Hz. Optional (not all brainsets carry this). Nullable.

field.name: unit_contamination
field.description: Per-unit contamination QC metric (fraction). Optional. Nullable.

field.name: unit_isi_violations
field.description: Per-unit ISI-violation rate. Optional. Nullable.

field.name: unit_presence_ratio
field.description: Per-unit presence ratio (fraction of session bins with at least one spike). Optional. Nullable.

field.name: session_task
field.description: Behavioral task label (e.g. REACHING). Empty for passive/free-viewing sessions.

field.name: device_recording_tech
field.description: Recording technology used for this session. Values include NEUROPIXELS_SPIKES, UTAH_ARRAY_SPIKES, UTAH_ARRAY_THRESHOLD_CROSSINGS.

field.name: subject_species
field.description: Subject species (e.g. MUS_MUSCULUS, MACACA_MULATTA, MACACA_FASCICULARIS). UNKNOWN for sessions without species metadata.

field.name: brainset_description
field.description: Per-brainset prose description carried in the H5 attrs.

field.name: brainset_source
field.description: Upstream source as written by the brainset's pipeline: usually the canonical URL (e.g. https://dandiarchive.org/dandiset/000409); c4_dataset_cerebellum_2025 stores a free-text label instead.

field.name: brainset_origin_version
field.description: Version identifier for the upstream source as written by the brainset's pipeline (e.g. dandi/000409, allen/vbn, 1.0.0). Format varies by brainset.

field.name: brainset_derived_version
field.description: Version of the brainsets-pipeline output schema (e.g. 1.0.0).
